category: contributed storage - hosted indexer over third-party hosts

free_tier.stated: Free 50 GB; Plus $7.99/mo for 500 GB; Pro $14.99/mo for 5 TB; Unlimited $19.99/mo for 10 TB, then +$4.99/TB-mo. 20 TiB = $19.99 + 10 x $4.99 = $69.89/mo

egress.terms: plans are quoted by storage volume and by speed cap (500 Mbps / 1 Gbps / 5 Gbps). Treat unmetered egress as UNVERIFIED.

interface_detail: S3-compatible via self-hosted s3d gateway; iOS/Android app; Sia Storage SDK (JS/Rust/Go/Python/Dart)
tooling: rclone, Cyberduck, Nextcloud, Synology Hyper Backup, Arq, AWS CLI - all named on the s3d page
chaining: s3d on a $3 VPS + rclone = an S3 endpoint whose bytes live on 530 independent hosts; put Cloudflare in front and egress becomes CF's problem
limits_note: Pricing is the good news and it is real: $2.00/TB/mo at the 10 TB tier, $4.99/TB beyond. 20 TiB for $69.89/mo is the cheapest honest 20 TiB quote found in this slot. The ceiling is the plan model - you buy a storage tier, not a per-byte rate, and the free tier is 50 GB, two orders of magnitude. Egress terms unverified.
reliability_note: Depends on third-party hosts remaining online; the network reports 2.19 PB used of 7.12 PB across 530 active hosts, so repair pressure is real but the margin is wide.
